mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status != 'CANCELLED' AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status = 'DONE' AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deadline IS NOT NULL AND deadline < CURDATE() AND status NOT IN ( 'DONE', 'CANCELLED' ) AND deleted = 0
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY status

SELECT DATE(completed_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS completedCount FROM task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status = 'DONE' AND completed_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(completed_time) >= #{startDate} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(completed_time) ORDER BY DATE(completed_time)

SELECT pm.user_id AS userId, CASE WHEN u.nickname IS NOT NULL AND u.nickname != '' THEN u.nickname ELSE u.username END AS memberName, u.avatar AS avatar, COUNT(DISTINCT ta.task_id) AS assignedCount,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.status = 'TODO' THEN t.id END) AS todoCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN t.id END) AS inProgressCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.status = 'IN_REVIEW' THEN t.id END) AS inReviewCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.status = 'DONE' THEN t.id END) AS doneCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN t.id END) AS cancelledCount,
COUNT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.deadline IS NOT NULL AND t.deadline < CURDATE() AND t.status NOT IN ('DONE', 'CANCELLED') THEN t.id END ) AS overdueCount
FROM project_member pm INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = pm.user_id LEFT JOIN task_assignee ta ON ta.user_id = pm.user_id LEFT JOIN task t ON t.id = ta.task_id AND t.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY pm.user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar ORDER BY assignedCount DESC, doneCount DESC, memberName ASC
